title: FloodConnect M8 official guidance row
description: One row of advice/official_guidance.yaml (P-D, not built in P-B) -- the cited-data-file backing for the official-parity hard rule (every FloodConnect step must be equal to or stricter than this). Sources: ปภ./DDPM (disaster.go.th), กรมอุตุฯ, กทม. (bangkok.go.th), สภากาชาดไทย, สธ./กรมควบคุมโรค (source_class OFFICIAL_TH), plus general-practice sources -- Ready.gov, gov.uk, American/IFRC Red Cross (source_class GENERAL). A news-site relay of agency advice is RELAYED, never a source for this schema -- an OFFICIAL_TH row is sourced only from the agency's own domain (a .go.th government public-relations relay of another Thai agency's own words, e.g. PRD/prd.go.th, counts as that agency's own domain; a private news outlet never does). An item that cannot be sourced is tag OPEN and carries no verbatim_th/url.

agency.description: Agency name verbatim, Thai where the agency's own text is Thai.

verbatim_th.description: The source's own text, verbatim -- never paraphrased into this field. Despite the name (kept for backward compatibility), a GENERAL row's text is English, not Thai.

tag.description: OPEN = could not be independently fetched/verbatim-confirmed; carries no text/url and is listed in advice/PARITY.md as open, never fails the parity test.

source_class.description: Required (non-null) when tag is OFFICIAL. OFFICIAL_TH = a Thai agency's own domain (or a .go.th relay of it). GENERAL = a non-Thai general-practice source (Ready.gov, gov.uk, American/IFRC Red Cross) -- never presented as a Thai agency's own position. Always null for an OPEN row (no source was ever fetched).
